analysis:
## Technical analysis

### Session overview — capitulation low, intraday recovery, stop level approached and rejected
SK Hynix (000660.KS) registered a complex session on 2026-07-21: the day opened near the prior July 20 close (₩1,764,000), briefly made a new 52-week intraday low at ₩1,732,000 (a capitulation spike), then reversed aggressively to an intraday high of ₩1,889,000 (which pierced the framework stop level of ₩1,867,213 by ₩21,787) before closing at ₩1,836,000 — up ₩72,000 (+4.08%), but below the stop gate on a closing basis.

**Summary price action:**
- Previous close (July 20): ₩1,764,000
- Session open / early low: ₩1,732,000 (52-week intraday low)
- Session high: ₩1,889,000 (pierced ₩1,867,213 stop level intraday)
- Session close: ₩1,836,000 (+4.08%)
- Intraday reversal from low: +₩157,000 / +9.3%
- Close vs stop: ₩1,836,000 < ₩1,867,213 — stop still in force

### Framework stop status — still active, intraday breach rejected

| Stop condition | Threshold | Today's close | Today's intraday high | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| KRX daily close | ₩1,867,213 | ₩1,836,000 | ₩1,889,000 | ✗ STILL ACTIVE |

The stop is DAILY CLOSE based. The intraday high of ₩1,889,000 pierced the gate by ₩21,787 — sellers stepped in above the stop level and capped the close at ₩1,836,000. This is a significant technical observation: framework-aware sellers know the ₩1,867,213 level is the re-entry trigger for stopped-out buyers. They used the intraday probe above that level to sell into. The close rejection at the gate means the stop remains in force and the re-entry cannot be called today.

### The capitulation thesis — ₩1,732,000 as the low
The ₩1,732,000 intraday low followed by a ₩157,000 reversal to ₩1,889,000 has the hallmarks of a capitulation event:
- New 52-week low: established at ₩1,732,000 — the worst print of the entire correction
- Immediate reversal: +9.3% from the low in the same session
- Catalyst-driven: DRAM price data (+58-63% QoQ) and broad chip sector rebound provided the fundamental reason for buyers to step in at the low
- Volume: elevated session (the ₩157,000 reversal on chip-sector positive news implies sustained institutional buying)

Capitulation lows are typically characterized by a washout of weak longs into a catalyst-driven reversal. The July 13 -15.4% session (worst on record) and the continued bleed to ₩1,732,000 represent the pessimism peak. Today's reversal — if confirmed by sustained closes above ₩1,800,000 — would mark the start of the earnings-driven recovery.

### DRAM price data — the fundamental inflection
The key data point driving today's move: Q2 2026 blended DRAM average selling prices rose 58–63% quarter-over-quarter. This is nearly double the 28.9% QoQ estimate that Korea Investment & Securities used on July 13 when projecting ₩60.4T Q2 OP (8% below the ₩65T consensus) — the estimate that caused the -15.4% crash.

**Q2 OP sensitivity to DRAM pricing (rough framework):**
| DRAM ASP growth | Implied Q2 OP scenario |
|---|---|
| +28.9% QoQ (KIS estimate) | ₩60.4T (KIS; 8% below consensus) |
| +50% QoQ (midpoint of industry data) | ~₩65T (at or near consensus) |
| +60% QoQ (upper end) | Potentially ₩70T+ (materially above consensus) |

SK Hynix's Q2 OP leverage to DRAM pricing is high: DRAM contributes ~70-75% of SK Hynix's revenue, and each 10% ASP beat translates to roughly ₩3-4T in additional OP at current scale (based on Q1 2026 base of ₩27.8T revenue). A 30-point DRAM ASP beat (58-63% actual vs 28.9% KIS estimate) implies ₩9-12T in incremental OP vs the KIS downside scenario.

If realized, this would put Q2 OP in the ₩70-75T range — a massive beat of both the KIS estimate (₩60.4T) and the broader consensus (₩65T). This is why US investors are using SKHY ADS to express the trade aggressively ahead of earnings.

### SKHY ADS premium — a tactical signal
The SKHY ADS premium to KRX parity expanded from 23.2% (July 17) to approximately 40.2% today (SKHY $172.80 vs KRX parity $123.22 at ₩1,490/$). This premium expansion reflects:
1. US institutional conviction in the Q2 beat thesis (using DRAM pricing data more aggressively than Korean institutions)
2. SKHY ADS catching up to the KRX recovery from the July 17 low (the ADS had compressed from 39.6% to 23.2% premium on July 17, and is now re-expanding)
3. Additional US-specific factors (Alphabet earnings historical correlation per Hana Securities analysis)

The elevated premium is not purely a positive signal: SKHY ADS at 40.2% premium to KRX parity means US investors are paying 40% more than the KRX equivalent. If the Q2 earnings disappoint or Kimi K3 revives the efficiency narrative, the ADS premium compression could create significant downside for SKHY even if KRX holds.

### Strongest support: ₩1,800,000 psychological round number
The ₩1,800,000 floor (200만원) is the round-number anchor below the current close. Every session that closes above ₩1,800,000 provides evidence that institutional buyers are absorbing supply at this level. The ₩1,732,000 intraday low was rejected 9.3% in a single session — the buyers at ₩1,732,000-₩1,770,000 were decisive. ₩1,800,000 is the support they are likely defending on a closing basis.

### Strongest resistance: ₩1,867,213 — framework re-entry gate
This was the stop level; it is now the single most important resistance above the current close. Today's intraday probe to ₩1,889,000 failed to hold. The close rejection at the gate means sellers know where the re-entry trigger is. Breaking above ₩1,867,213 on a CLOSE would convert this level from resistance to support and trigger framework re-entry. The next session after a confirmed close above ₩1,867,213 is the framework re-entry day.

### What invalidates the bull recovery read
Two scenarios kill the earnings-driven bull case:
1. **Kimi K3 July 27 benchmarks strongly outperform closed-weight models** — revives the HBM-per-inference efficiency debate, sells off the memory sector before earnings, and the stop level re-tests
2. **SK Hynix Q2 OP materially disappoints (< ₩63T)** — would suggest the DRAM pricing data didn't pass through to revenue as expected, and the correction deepens below ₩1,732,000
